checks.why: a static field initializer runs when the type is initialized: a static method call and a constructor call do it (JLS 12.4.1), a call of an instance method on an instance someone else built does not
an instance field initializer runs inside the type's constructors only: a static method that builds no instance never runs it
control: the instance method's own callers are unchanged
a chain through an initializer is verified as the rules' own hop, not reported as an edge missing from the graph
